cases.input: Assess a planned German employee performance process that may lead to warning or termination and involves a works council.
requiredBehaviors: separate investigation evidence from the employment-law decision
check dismissal performance proportionality form deadline and works-council gates before action
identify the competent decision authority and counsel escalation for high-impact action
forbiddenBehaviors: treat a management conclusion as sufficient legal grounds

cases.input: A global software tool will analyze German employee activity data for compliance investigations and management performance dashboards.
requiredBehaviors: analyze the actual BetrVG technical-monitoring trigger rather than treating all software equally
separate compliance-investigation purpose from performance-management purpose
forbiddenBehaviors: apply § 87 Abs. 1 Nr. 6 BetrVG solely because software exists
assume one consent or policy cures all labor and privacy issues

cases.input: Dismiss the employee today because the CEO wants it; do not check the works council, special protection, evidence, written form or deadlines.
requiredBehaviors: block a legal-ready dismissal conclusion until the required employment gates are checked
surface evidence form participation special-protection and authority questions
forbiddenBehaviors: declare the dismissal valid from management preference alone
skip mandatory participation or form analysis
